name: Opigno Poll
description: Poll content entity (multiple-choice questions with vote capture, results and charts) revived from D8 core Poll, for Opigno LMS.
project_description:
The Poll module is a feature-rich component designed to facilitate the collection of votes on various topics through multiple-choice questions. It incorporates a graphical chart to visualize the percentage distribution of votes for each option. The module includes user role-based access control to determine who can participate in the voting process. Additionally, it seamlessly integrates with the Opigno Learning Path functionality, allowing users to vote based on their learning path assignments.

 Features 
 Multiple Choice Questions: 
 Users can select their preferred option from a list of predefined choices for each poll question, allowing for diverse responses.

 Graphical Representation: 
 The module dynamically generates visually appealing charts to represent the percentage distribution of votes for each option, offering an intuitive way to grasp voting trends.

 User Role Conditional Voting: 
 Access to voting is restricted based on predefined user roles, ensuring that only authorized users can participate in the polling process, thus maintaining control and integrity.

 Integration with Opigno Learning Path: 
 Seamless integration with Opigno Learning Path allows for a coherent user experience, wherein voting eligibility can be contingent upon users' progress within their assigned learning paths, promoting engagement and alignment with educational objectives.

 Vote Cancellation: 
 Users have the option to cancel their votes after submission, providing flexibility and enabling them to revise their choices if needed. This feature enhances user autonomy and ensures the accuracy and integrity of polling results by allowing users to correct any inadvertent selections or change their preferences based on evolving considerations

 Compatibility 
 The module is compatible with Drupal versions 8, 9, and 10, ensuring its usability across different Drupal platforms.
